evidence.locator: text: opening grant paragraph ("Redistribution and use in source and binary forms, with or without modification, are permitted" subject to conditions 1-3; broad non-reciprocal permission identifies a permissive family)

text: opening grant and conditions 1-3, plus the Enhancements paragraph (permissions are non-reciprocal; no same-license, source-disclosure, corresponding-source, linking, or network-use condition is stated)

text: opening grant paragraph (redistribution and use in source and binary forms, with or without modification, are permitted without a purpose limitation) and Enhancements paragraph (explicit non-exclusive, royalty-free, perpetual rights to install, use, modify, prepare derivatives, incorporate, distribute, and sublicense Enhancements)

text: conditions (1) and (2) (source redistributions must retain, and binary redistributions must reproduce in documentation or other materials, the copyright notice, list of conditions, and following disclaimer; no source-disclosure or corresponding-source duty is stated)
